trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Ruben: Out of the cave at last! Don't relax yet: this side of Victory Road is harder than the other.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Ruben: Harder for me than for you, it seems.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Maxwell: Shh. The spirits of this headland were whispering about you just now.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Maxwell: They whispered that I would lose. I had hoped they were joking.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Carl: A hundred laps of this meadow before lunch! You've wandered onto my track!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Carl: Ninety-nine laps, and a lesson. Good!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Armando: Forty years a trainer, and I still walk out to the end of the land to see who turns up.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Armando: Someone worth the walk turned up today.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Brittney: Don't tell me which Pokémon you'll send out first. I already know!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Brittney: I knew how it would end, too. I just didn't want to believe it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Jamie: I saw you from right across the grass. One Pokémon is all I carry, and all I need for you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Jamie: Four legs of steel, and you still knocked it flat.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ruin Maniac Larry: That white rock on the point is older than any ruin in Sinnoh. Hands off! I saw it first!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ruin Maniac Larry: Look, then. But don't chip it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Hayden: Round and round I turn, and whoever I'm facing when they walk by battles my dragons!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Hayden: Now I'm dizzy as well as beaten.
